subject: 🐋 Should we keep writing to you?
preview: One tap to stay. Nothing to do if you'd rather we stop.
h1_light: We haven't heard from you in a while.
h1_bold: Do you still want our emails?

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: We'd rather write to fewer people who find our emails useful than fill everyone's inbox. If you want to keep getting them, tap below and nothing changes.
If we don't hear back within 14 days, we'll stop emailing you. Your MindSync account and everything in it stay exactly as they are.

buttons.label: YES, KEEP ME ON THE LIST

blocks.text: Either way, thanks for giving MindSync a try. If something put you off, hit reply. One line helps.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.
